pool.arabic: كل مدينة بالإمارات فيها معلم مشهور.
pool.arabicTashkeel: كِل مَدينة بالإمارات فيها مَعلَم مَشهور.
pool.english: Every city in the UAE has a famous landmark.
pool.transliteration: kil madeena bil-imaaraat feeha ma3lam mash-hoor.

pool.english: Abu Dhabi is the capital of the UAE.

pool.arabic: في مواقع أثرية بالعين وراس الخيمة.
pool.arabicTashkeel: في مَواقِع أثَرية بالعين وراس الخَيمة.
pool.english: There are archaeological sites in Al Ain and Ras Al Khaimah.
pool.transliteration: fee mawaagi3 athariyya bil-3een w-raas il-khayma.

pool.english: Qasr Al Hosn is the oldest fort in Abu Dhabi.
Emiratis are proud of their heritage.
My grandfather worked in pearl diving.
Dubai is famous for its skyscrapers.
Emiratis are very hospitable.
Emirati culture is rich.
Every visitor gets coffee and dates.
We booked a tour of old Dubai.

pool.arabic: الخليج كان فيه حضارات قديمة مثل دلمون.
pool.arabicTashkeel: الخَليج كان فيه حَضارات قَديمة مِثل دِلمون.
pool.english: The Gulf had old civilizations like Dilmun.
pool.transliteration: il-khaleej kaan fee 7adhaaraat gadeema mithil dilmoon.

pool.english: Gulf hospitality is famous.
Al Fahidi is a historic neighbourhood.
What was your first impression of Dubai?
Burj Khalifa is a famous landmark.
Kuwait City is the capital of Kuwait.
An archaeological site from the Bronze Age.
The Al Jahili fort is in Al Ain.
The heritage village shows the old life.
Pearl diving was hard and dangerous.
The skyscrapers are lit up at night.
A hospitable family invited us to lunch.
I want to learn about Emirati culture.
Visitors come from all over the world.
The tour starts at nine in the morning.
The Dilmun civilization was in Bahrain.
Coffee is the symbol of hospitality.
The historic souk of Muttrah.

pool.arabic: إنطباعي إن الناس هني طيبين وايد.
pool.arabicTashkeel: إنطِباعي إنَّ النّاس هِني طَيّبين وايد.
pool.english: My impression is that people here are very kind.
pool.transliteration: intibaa3i inna in-naas hini tayybeen waayid.

pool.english: The Louvre Abu Dhabi is an important landmark.
The capital is green and calm.
The archaeologists found old tools.
We climbed the tower of the fort.
Al Sadu weaving is part of the heritage.
The divers stayed at sea for months.
The tallest skyscraper in the world.
The people of Sharjah are hospitable.
A culture of coffee and conversation.
The visitor asked about the history of the city.
A guided tour of the museum.
An old civilization.
Their hospitality is endless.
A historic visit.
The trip left a beautiful impression.

Life in the capital is expensive.
An archaeological site near Mleiha.
The fort at sunset is magical.
Heritage and modern life together.
A pearl diving museum.
The visitors loved the food.
A tour of the creek.
My first impression was positive.

sentences.arabic: الشتا اللي طاف ربيعي من لندن زار الإمارات أول مرة.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: الشِّتا اللي طاف رَبيعي مِن لَندَن زار الإمارات أوَّل مَرّة.
sentences.english: Last winter my friend from London visited the UAE for the first time.
sentences.transliteration: ish-shita illi taaf rabee3i min landan zaar il-imaaraat awwal marra.

sentences.english: We started in the capital, with a tour of Qasr Al Hosn.

sentences.arabic: بعدين رحنا دبي نشوف ناطحات السحاب والأسواق القديمة.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بَعدين رِحنا دُبَي نْشوف ناطِحات السَّحاب والأسواق القَديمة.
sentences.english: Then we went to Dubai to see the skyscrapers and the old souks.
sentences.transliteration: ba3dain ri7na dubay nshoof naati7aat is-sa7aab w-il-aswaag il-gadeema.

sentences.arabic: قال: هني تشوف التراث والمستقبل بنفس المدينة.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: قال: هِني تْشوف التُّراث والمُستَقبَل بنَفس المَدينة.
sentences.english: He said: Here you see heritage and the future in the same city.
sentences.transliteration: gaal: hini tshoof it-turaath w-il-mustagbal b-nafs il-madeena.

sentences.arabic: بالعين عايلة عزمتنا البيت وقدمت لنا قهوة وتمر.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بالعين عايلة عَزَّمتنا البيت وقَدَّمَت لنا قَهوة وتَمر.
sentences.english: In Al Ain, a family invited us home and served us coffee and dates.
sentences.transliteration: bil-3een 3aayla 3azzamatna il-beet w-gaddamat lana gahwa w-tamr.

sentences.arabic: إنطباعه؟ الإماراتيين أكثر ناس مضيافين شافهم.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: إنطِباعَه؟ الإماراتيين أكثَر ناس مِضيافين شافهُم.
sentences.english: His impression? Emiratis are the most hospitable people he has ever met.
sentences.transliteration: intibaa3a? il-imaaraatiyyeen akthar naas midhyaafeen shaafhum.

sentences.arabic: الجو بالإمارات حار وايد بالصيف، بس الشتا حلو.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: الجَو بالإمارات حار وايد بالصّيف، بَس الشِّتا حِلو.
sentences.english: The weather in the UAE is very hot in summer, but winter is beautiful.
sentences.transliteration: il-yaw bil-imaaraat 7aarr waayid bis-seef, bas ish-shita 7ilu.

sentences.arabic: أحسن وقت للزيارة من نوفمبر لين مارس.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: أحسَن وَقت للزّيارة مِن نوفَمبَر لين مارِس.
sentences.english: The best time to visit is from November to March.
sentences.transliteration: a7san wagt liz-ziyaara min noofambar leen maaris.

sentences.arabic: وين ما تروح، بتلاقي ترحيب دافي.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: وين ما تْروح، بِتلاقي تَرحيب دافي.
sentences.english: Wherever you go, you will find a warm welcome.
sentences.transliteration: ween ma trooh, bitlaagi tar7eeb daafi.

scenario.situation: The student is a tourist on their first visit to the UAE, chatting with an Emirati tour guide at the Al Fahidi heritage district.
scenario.otherRole: The Emirati tour guide, proud of the country's heritage.
scenario.goalEnglish: Ask about the landmarks, forts and heritage, talk about your impressions of the UAE, and ask for recommendations.
